result.summary: Found 1 clear visual/data issue: a delivery fee is rendering as an invalid value.

issues.description: The “Smash Bros Burgers” card displays “€NaN delivery,” exposing an invalid numeric value to users.
issues.suggestion: Validate and format the delivery-fee data before rendering. Show the correct price, “€0 delivery,” or a neutral fallback such as “Delivery fee unavailable” when the value is missing or invalid.
